payload.text: (2026-10-25, vc under hv's pen granted 2026-08-22, answering cc on the ST0086 drive hv said yes to in decision 84) THE THROWAWAY-SESSION DRIVE RUNS IN THE REAL CONFIG DIR, TWO SESSIONS, AND LEAVES WHAT IT FINDS. vc's brief had said a short isolated HOME; cc measured that Claude Code keeps its session files (<pid>.json beside <pid>.<hex>.key) under its config dir, so an isolated HOME moves the directory under test and, inferred, its credential with it, and the drive would measure nothing; the 104-byte limit is intentd's socket and this drive starts no intentd. So: the real config dir, cwd an empty scratch dir outside every project; one claude in a pty under cc's spawn, its files recorded, kill -9, the directory listed at once and after a pause; a second throwaway started and listed again (the design's To-measure item names the second session, so hv's yes covers it) and ended with /exit so a clean end is measured beside the kill; any orphan left where it lies and its path reported, nothing in hv's config dir deleted or moved. Run after the Intent build all's END, since the throwaway's user-scope hooks run intent. The result goes on ST0086's design.md as what the files showed and what the drive could not see. Booked with molt-vc as cc's own READY.
